title: Professional Certificate in Developing Human Resource Management, Recruitment And Selection
description: The course aims to prepare the learner with the underlying considerations required for successful recruitment and selection.
longDescription: Understand the requirement of human resource management. Learn about personal identification requirements. Understand what is recruitment and its types. Understand the meaning of selection and the different methods of selection. The factors influencing the selection and recruitment process. Learn about employee motivation. The different ways to enhance employee motivation. The various national level HR policies. Professional Certificate in Developing Human Resource Management, Recruitment, and Selection explores key concepts in the development function of human resource management, focusing on recruitment and selection.
